name: The Lodge at Blue Sky,  Auberge Collection
insider_take: This luxury ranch retreat sits on 3,500 pristine acres where Robert Redford filmed parts of "A River Runs Through It," offering authentic Western experiences just minutes from Park City's world-class skiing.
whats_special: The Lodge features its own working cattle ranch with over 50 miles of private trails, a championship fly-fishing program on the Provo River, and Utah's largest collection of vintage Western art. The property maintains a herd of bison and offers horseback riding through aspen groves that turn golden each fall.
pro_tip: Book the "Cowboy for a Day" experience during summer months - you'll help move cattle across the property's vast meadows while learning traditional ranching techniques from genuine Utah cowboys.
dont_miss: The sunset horseback ride to Scout's Lookout offers panoramic views of the Wasatch Mountains, and the property's saloon features rare whiskeys aged in barrels made from trees that grew on the ranch itself.
pros: Stunning mountain views and pristine wilderness setting
Luxurious accommodations with rustic mountain elegance
cons: Remote mountain location requires drive to Park City center
Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
